comparison.objective: Insert the correctly polarized final magnet into a rotor while preventing its loose neighbor from jumping out.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual hold-while-inserting under modeled magnetic forces and pole-order selection.
comparison.success_condition: Red-topped magnet flush within stated pose tolerances, adjacent magnet never rises over 6 mm, and arms return for full score.
comparison.reason: Both demand bimanual stabilization, but this record tests force-coupled insertion and polarity; the candidate tests hammer-driven material separation and recovery of four fragments without coil damage.
